outcome: A user can edit their own display name and bio.

acceptance_criteria.text: Editing the display name and bio updates them.

expected_verification.assertion: a profile edit updates both fields

acceptance_criteria.text: A submitted edit cannot change a field the user is not permitted to set, such as their role or verification state.

expected_verification.assertion: an edit naming role or email_verified leaves both unchanged

security_impact: Privilege escalation to administrator by an ordinary authenticated user, through the profile edit form.
rollback: git revert removes the edit endpoint.
